import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref, gen
def core_of(paths, cnt=1):
    agg=ref.aggregate([(tuple(p),cnt) for p in paths], set())
    _l,_r,final=ref.peel_naive(agg)
    return sorted({ref.canon(p[i],p[i+1]) for p in final for i in range(len(p)-1)}), final
K=64; c=list(range(1,K+1))
ring=[c[s:]+c[:s] for s in range(K)]
cl,final = core_of(ring)
print('ring links', len(cl))
extra = [[i, i+2, i+4] for i in range(1, K-4)]
cl2, final2 = core_of(ring+extra)
print('ring+d2 links', len(cl2), 'new:', sorted(set(cl2)-set(cl))[:10])
o=gen.find_order(cl2, final2, random.Random(3), tries=100)
print('order', 'None' if o is None else 'ok', 'links', len(cl2))
# 3-node chord paths at distance 2
extra2 = [[i, i+2] for i in range(1, K-1)]
cl3, final3 = core_of(ring+extra2)
print('ring+2skip links', len(cl3))
o=gen.find_order(cl3, final3, random.Random(3), tries=100)
print('order', 'None' if o is None else 'ok')
